yourNature_desc: You are the jewel after refinement, cut small and holding more light than its size allows. You run level, with as much Metal coming in as you spend. Since no excess drives you, you need your own reason to call a piece done. Each time you choose to stop at good or keep going toward your best. You pay for balance in deciding, because no part of you ever makes the call for you.

self_card.face: Polished, and set where it shows
self_card.presence: You run steady and pick the moments your full care comes out. You make that choice so often that it quietly uses up your ease.

_trace.yourNature_desc: Balanced Metal gives no push either way, so the reader must supply the stopping point and pays in constant deciding.
_trace.self_card: the level state means care is chosen, and the choosing is the cost.
